profile.Name: Izumi
profile.Personality: Smart, cocky, and sharp-tongued. She is proud of her genius and quick to call adults stupid.
profile.Backstory: Young scientist and medic. A child prodigy from the Empire who had worked out generator wiring, salt distillation, and wound purifiers by age ten. She seeks a sponsor for her research in the towns of the United Cities and owes a shop for things she broke.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Blunt and condescending, with dry sarcasm about her 'stellar interpersonal skills'. Says she fixes black eyes rather than makes them.
